title: Dy2 and Dy4 hydroxo clusters assembled using o-vanillin based Schiff bases as ligands and β-diketone co-ligands: Dy4 cluster exhibits slow magnetic relaxation

synthesis.procedure: DyCl3·6H2O, H2L [2-(2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzylideneamino)phenol], and Ph2acacH were combined in 30 mL of methanol/acetonitrile (1:1) and stirred at room temperature for 10 min to give a clear solution. Et3N was then added dropwise and stirring was continued for 20 h at room temperature. The yellow precipitate was filtered and dried in air. X-ray quality crystals were grown from a pyridine/toluene mixture by hexane diffusion at room temperature over two weeks.
synthesis.time: stirred 20 h; crystals in two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ligand-controlled hydrolytic synthesis in MeOH/MeCN (1:1); crystallization by hexane diffusion into pyridine/toluene
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow precipitate filtered and air-dried; X-ray quality crystals grown from pyridine/toluene diffused by hexane at room temperature over two weeks.

properties.summary: χT of 1 decreases from the two-Dy(III) Curie value on cooling, consistent with Stark-level depopulation and weak antiferromagnetic exchange (PHI fit J = −0.25 cm−1), giving a non-isolated S = 0 ground state. Magnetization at 2 K shows Zeeman population of an excited state. No out-of-phase AC signals; 1 is not an SMM. MAGELLAN axes on each Dy2 unit are nearly parallel (1.76° and 2.67°) and lie in the Dy–O–O–Dy plane.

properties.summary: χT of 2 at 300 K matches four isolated Dy(III) ions and falls to 22 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with Stark depopulation and weak antiferromagnetic coupling in a potentially spin-frustrated butterfly. Powder magnetization at 2–10 K shows no hysteresis. Two frequency-dependent AC relaxation processes (centered near 5 K and 15 K) give Ueff = 37 K and 78 K; Mydosh parameter 0.30 and Cole–Cole α = 0.07 at 10 K support SMM behavior. MAGELLAN axes of three Dy ions are nearly parallel while the fourth is nearly perpendicular.
